bands.label: Higher B1
bands.descriptor: B1 descriptors; all three questions on topic.

bands.label: Lower B1
bands.descriptor: B1 descriptors; two questions on topic.

bands.label: Higher A2
bands.descriptor: A2 descriptors; at least two questions on topic.

bands.label: Lower A2
bands.descriptor: A2 descriptors; one question on topic.

bands.label: Below A2
bands.descriptor: Below A2, or no meaningful language, or all responses completely off-topic.

B1.grammar: Simple grammatical structures are used correctly. Errors occur when attempting complex structures.
B1.vocabulary: There is sufficient range and control of vocabulary for the task. Errors occur when expressing complex thoughts.
B1.pronunciation: Pronunciation is generally intelligible but mispronunciations put an occasional strain on the listener.
B1.fluency: There is some pausing, false starts, and reformulations.
B1.cohesion: Uses only simple cohesive devices. Links between ideas are not always clearly indicated.

A2.grammar: Some simple grammatical structures are used correctly but basic mistakes systematically occur.
A2.vocabulary: Vocabulary is sufficient to respond to the questions, although inappropriate word choices are noticeable.
A2.pronunciation: Mispronunciations are noticeable and frequently place a strain on the listener.
A2.fluency: There is frequent pausing, false starts, and reformulations.
A2.cohesion: Cohesion between ideas is limited. Responses tend to be a list of points.

above_B1.grammar: Some complex grammar constructions are used accurately. Errors do not impede understanding.
above_B1.vocabulary: The range of vocabulary is sufficient to discuss the topics required by the task. Inappropriate lexical choices do not impede understanding.
above_B1.pronunciation: Pronunciation is intelligible. Mispronunciations do not put a strain on the listener or lead to misunderstanding.
above_B1.fluency: Some pausing while searching for vocabulary but this does not put a strain on the listener.
above_B1.cohesion: A limited number of cohesive devices are used to indicate the links between ideas.

below_A2.grammar: Grammatical structure is limited to words and phrases. Errors in basic patterns and simple grammar structures impede understanding.
below_A2.vocabulary: Vocabulary is limited to very basic words related to personal information.
below_A2.pronunciation: Pronunciation is mostly unintelligible except for isolated words.
below_A2.fluency: Frequent pausing, false starts, and reformulations impede understanding.

descriptor_sources.B1: Official UZBMB Multilevel speaking rating scale, Questions 4-6, B1 (bands 4 and 3).
descriptor_sources.A2: Official UZBMB Multilevel speaking rating scale, Questions 4-6, A2 (bands 2 and 1).
descriptor_sources.above_B1: Reference only: the official Question 7 B2 text, used only to recognise language above B1. Never band text.
descriptor_sources.below_A2: Reference only: the official Questions 1-3 A1 text (no cohesion: the Questions 4-6 A2 cohesion text is the lowest, so cohesion is below A2 only when even that is not met). Never band text.
